name: tavernweave-agent-skills
description: A routed SillyTavern rolecard engineering system with resumable creative authority, bundled guides and design references, evidence gates, and optional portable teaching personas.

interface.shortDescription: Design, build, verify, and learn SillyTavern rolecards.
interface.longDescription: TavernWeave combines 18 focused skills with a resumable creative-authority contract, material provenance, layered acceptance evidence, a bundled routed library of ST guides and frontend design or motion references, an offline picker, and optional current-task Atong or MTTT.sir teaching personas.
defaultPrompt: 阿瞳助我！用当前任务级温柔指导模式帮我完成这张角色卡。
MTTT.sir，拷打我！检查我是否真的理解这次 Vibe Code 的架构与验收。
